dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.teller:
Panicking Colleague
惊慌失措的同事
dataList.content:
Enemy inbound! 100 meters!
前方敌人接近！100米！

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.teller:
Anxious Colleague
焦躁不安的同事
dataList.content:
Crap… We’re out of ammo, too…
“可恶……已经没有子弹了……”

It was a clear emergency. The darkly clad children were terrified by an unknown threat with which they didn’t know how to deal.
这显然是任谁看来都十万火急的情况。用黑色衣物包裹着全身的孩子们，因为想不出应对敌人的方法而惊慌失措。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.teller:
Anxious Colleague
焦躁不安的同事
dataList.content:
Dammit… Should’ve known bringing less to save the company budget was a bad call!
妈的……真不该想着为公司节省开支而少带子弹的！

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.teller:
Panicking Colleague
惊慌失措的同事
dataList.content:
Not like we could earn a better review from HR or anything, so why’d… Ope.
明明就算那样人事的评价也不会变好，到底为什么要做这种……啊。

The child’s mouth went shut, for it suddenly dawned on them that their gun had stopped firing its projectiles.
孩子瞠目结舌。因为不管怎么扣动扳机，都不再有子弹飞出去了。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.teller:
Panicking Colleague
惊慌失措的同事

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.teller:
Anxious Colleague
焦躁不安的同事
dataList.content:
So this is the end for us…
到此为止了吗……

That’s when their savior appeared, waving her golden-hour hair.
就在这时，他们的救世主飘扬着晚霞一般的头发登场了。

Relax you two. I’ll take charge from here.
请放心，这之后由我来解决。

LCCB 系长
LCCB
dataList.teller:

dataList.content:
With her shield raised, the child stared down her oncoming foe with unwavering resolve.
举着巨大盾牌的孩子用坚定的眼神瞪着敌人，

This is Ishmael. I’ve joined up with the team at Operation Site BA21. Will help them wipe out the damn rats. Over.
这里是以实玛利，于作战区域BA21会合，将会协助友军清理那些耗子。完毕。
dataList.title:
LCCB Assistant Manager
LCCB 系长

dataList.content:
Her firearm emitted flashes of light, a semaphore of salvation.
她的枪口射出的火光，宛如救世的圣光。

Ah, and also… Please refrain from making idiotic suggestions such as conserving the LCC’s ammo in the future. We have well-heeled sponsors backing us.
啊……我们有雄厚的资金支持，以后还请不要再提出类似于节省LCC的弹药的愚蠢建议。
dataList.title:
LCCB Assistant Manager
LCCB 系长

dataList.content:
…Along with flags of scathing lectures.
……标志性的严厉毒舌也如影随形。
